Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Giancarlo Stanton?

Giancarlo Stanton is 36 years old.

When was Giancarlo Stanton born?

Giancarlo Stanton was born on November 8, 1989.

Where was Giancarlo Stanton born?

Giancarlo Stanton was born in Panorama City, CA.

How tall is Giancarlo Stanton?

Giancarlo Stanton is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Giancarlo Stanton weigh?

Giancarlo Stanton weighs 245 lbs (111 kg).

How many seasons has Giancarlo Stanton played?

Giancarlo Stanton is in his 17th season.

When was Giancarlo Stanton drafted?

Giancarlo Stanton was drafted by the Florida Marlins in the 2nd round of the 2007 MLB June Amateur Draft from Notre Dame HS (Sherman Oaks, CA).

What position does Giancarlo Stanton play?

Giancarlo Stanton is a Rightfielder and Designated Hitter.

How many hits does Giancarlo Stanton have?

Giancarlo Stanton has 23 hits this season and has 1,642 hits over his career.

How many home runs does Giancarlo Stanton have?

Giancarlo Stanton has 3 home runs this season and has 456 home runs over his career.

What is Giancarlo Stanton's average?

Giancarlo Stanton has a .256 average this season and has a .258 average over his career.

How much is Giancarlo Stanton worth?

Giancarlo Stanton makes $29,000,000.00 this year. His current contract terms are 13 yrs/$325M (15-27) & 28 team option.

How many teams has Giancarlo Stanton played for?

Giancarlo Stanton has played for 2 teams; the Miami Marlins and New York Yankees.

How many World Series has Giancarlo Stanton won?

Giancarlo Stanton has never won a World Series.

What is Giancarlo Stanton's Instagram account?

Giancarlo Stanton is on Instagram at giancarlo818.

What are Giancarlo Stanton's nicknames?

Bigfoot, Cruz, G, Parmigiancarlo are nicknames for Giancarlo Stanton.
